data.name: CredentialsWithoutUserName
data.value: CupsOptions.Credentials has no user name. Set its UserName, or leave Credentials unset to send none.

data.name: CredentialsUserNameHasColon
data.value: The user name in CupsOptions.Credentials can't contain ':', which HTTP Basic authentication uses to separate it from the password.

data.name: InvalidCupsServerFromEnvironment
data.value: The CUPS_SERVER environment variable is set to '{0}', which isn't a valid CUPS server, so CUPS can't be used. Set it to a socket path such as /run/cups/cups.sock or a host name with an optional port such as printserver:631, or unset it.
data.comment: {0} is the environment variable's value. Raised by every CUPS request, so the printer catalog can still offer other print systems.

data.name: InvalidCupsServer
data.value: '{0}' is not a valid CUPS server. Use a socket path such as /run/cups/cups.sock, or a host name with an optional port such as printserver:631.
